name: District of Columbia
notes: bbox is [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat], matching pmtiles extract --bbox. The District's extent (Census TIGER, rounded outward). DC is tiny (~0.2 x 0.2 degrees), so the box is a handful of tiles and also covers the inner Maryland and Virginia suburbs. maxzoom 14 is where OSM street geometry stops adding detail; z15+ roughly doubles the file for labels the phone can render from z14 data.

geofabrik.notes: Not used for the roads basemap (Protomaps already renders the planet). It is the input the routing graph needs, and the state.txt timestamp is what check_upstream.py watches for maps-routing-us-dc.
